58091-the-honorable-miss-moonlight.title: Miss Moonlight
58091-the-honorable-miss-moonlight.creator: Unknown
58091-the-honorable-miss-moonlight.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It was the season of little heat, when an all-encompassing humidity seemed suspended over the land. Sky and earth were of one monotonous color, a dim blue, which faded to shadowy grayness at the fall of the twilight.

arxiv-2110-08319.title: A Proof of the Optimal Leapfrogging Conjecture
arxiv-2110-08319.creator: Sam K. Miller, Arthur T. Benjamin
arxiv-2110-08319.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by Sam K. Miller, Arthur T. Benjamin. 1
Introduction

Suppose we have some checkers placed in the lower left corner of a Go board, and we wish to move them to the upper right corner in as few moves as possible. There are no opponent pieces present, and the pieces move as they would in the game of Chinese Checkers, where for one move, a piece may either shift one unit in any direction, or repeatedly leapfrog over other pieces.

arxiv-2202-03961.title: Predicting Voting Outcomes in the Presence of Communities, Echo Chambers and Multiple Parties
arxiv-2202-03961.creator: Jacques Bara, Omer Lev, Paolo Turrini
arxiv-2202-03961.description: Abstract When individuals interact in a social network their opinions can change, at times quite significantly, as a result of social influence. In elections, for example, while they might initially support one candidate, what their friends say may lead them to support another. But how do opinions settle in a social network, as a result of social influence?

arxiv-2204-08373.title: Learning to Execute Actions or Ask Clarification Questions
arxiv-2204-08373.creator: Zhengxiang Shi, Yue Feng, Aldo Lipani
arxiv-2204-08373.description: Abstract Collaborative tasks are ubiquitous activities where a form of communication is required in order to reach a joint goal. Collaborative building is one of such tasks. We wish to develop an intelligent builder agent in a simulated building environment (Minecraft) that can build whatever users wish to build by just talking to the agent.

arxiv-2206-09501.title: DoG-HiT: A novel VLBI Multiscale Imaging Approach
arxiv-2206-09501.creator: H.Müller, A.P. Lobanov
arxiv-2206-09501.description: Abstract Context. Reconstructing images from very long baseline interferometry (VLBI) data with sparse sampling of the Fourier domain ( uv -coverage) constitutes an ill-posed deconvolution problem. It requires application of robust algorithms maximizing the information extraction from all of the sampled spatial scales and minimizing the influence of the unsampled scales on image quality. Aims.

arxiv-2407-10052.title: Augmented Neural Fine-Tuning for Efficient Backdoor Purification
arxiv-2407-10052.creator: Nazmul Karim, Abdullah Al Arafat, Umar Khalid, Zhishan Guo, Nazanin Rahnavard
arxiv-2407-10052.description: Abstract Recent studies have revealed the vulnerability of deep neural networks (DNNs) to various backdoor attacks, where the behavior of DNNs can be compromised by utilizing certain types of triggers or poisoning mechanisms. State-of-the-art (SOTA) defenses employ too-sophisticated mechanisms that require either a computationally expensive adversarial search module for reverse-engineering the trigger distribution or an over-sensitive hyper-parameter selection module.

arxiv-2412-17873.title: Revisit Hamiltonian S 1 S^{1} -manifolds of dimension 6 with 4 fixed points Thanks: 2020 classification. 53D05, 53D20, 55N25, 57R20
arxiv-2412-17873.creator: Hui Li
arxiv-2412-17873.description: Abstract . If the circle acts in a Hamiltonian way on a compact symplectic manifold of dimension 2 ​ n 2n , then there are at least n + 1 n+1 fixed points. The case that there are exactly n + 1 n+1 isolated fixed points has its importance due to various reasons.

arxiv-2504-08024.title: Summarizing Speech: A Comprehensive Survey
arxiv-2504-08024.creator: Fabian Retkowski Maike Züfle Andreas Sudmann Dinah Pfau, Shinji Watanabe Jan Niehues Alexander Waibel
arxiv-2504-08024.description: Abstract Speech summarization has become an essential tool for efficiently managing and accessing the growing volume of spoken and audiovisual content. However, despite its increasing importance, speech summarization remains loosely defined. The field intersects with several research areas, including speech recognition, text summarization, and specific applications like meeting summarization.

arxiv-2505-02148.title: Spotting the Unexpected (STU): A 3D LiDAR Dataset for Anomaly Segmentation in Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2505-02148.creator: Alexey Nekrasov, Malcolm Burdorf, Stewart Worrall, Bastian Leibe, Julie Stephany Berrio Perez, RWTH Aachen University, The University of Sydney https://vision.rwth-aachen.de/stu-dataset
arxiv-2505-02148.description: Abstract To operate safely, autonomous vehicles (AVs) need to detect and handle unexpected objects or anomalies on the road. While significant research exists for anomaly detection and segmentation in 2D, research progress in 3D is underexplored. Existing datasets lack high-quality multimodal data that are typically found in AVs. This paper presents a novel dataset for anomaly segmentation in driving scenarios.

arxiv-2508-16654.title: MSNav: Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation with Dynamic Memory and LLM Spatial Reasoning
arxiv-2508-16654.creator: Chenghao Liu, Zhimu Zhou, Jiachen Zhang, Minghao Zhang, Songfang Huang, Huiling Duan
arxiv-2508-16654.description: Abstract Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an agent to interpret natural language instructions and navigate complex environments. Current approaches often adopt a ”black-box” paradigm, where a single Large Language Model (LLM) makes end-to-end decisions. However, it is plagued by critical vulnerabilities, including poor spatial reasoning, weak cross-modal grounding, and memory overload in long-horizon tasks.

pmc-11353069.title: Perinatal Outcomes of Singleton, Twin and Triplet Gestations after Oocyte Donation: A Retrospective, Population-Based Cohort Analysis
pmc-11353069.creator: Or Eliner, Roni Rahav Koren, Hila Shalev Ram, Mattan Levi, Einat Haikin Herzberger, Amir Wiser, Netanella Miller
pmc-11353069.description: Background/Objectives: Although high live birth rates are associated with oocyte donation (OD), these pregnancies are associated with increased obstetric and perinatal risks. This study evaluated maternal and neonatal risks after OD compared to in vitro fertilization (IVF) with autologous oocytes, and to spontaneous pregnancies (SPs), among singletons, twins and triplets.

pmc-11547071.title: The Detailed Analysis of Polish Patients with Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Through Insights from Molecular Testing (POL-MOL Study)
pmc-11547071.creator: Dariusz M Kowalski, Magdalena Zaborowska-Szmit, Maciej Bryl, Agnieszka Byszek, Dariusz Adam Dziedzic, Piotr Jaśkiewicz, Renata Langfort, Maciej Krzakowski, Tadeusz Orłowski, Rodryg Ramlau, Sebastian Szmit, Aaron C Tan
pmc-11547071.description: Molecular testing is recommended in patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), but the extent of its use in Poland is unknown. The aim of the POL-MOL study was to investigate the frequency of using molecular testing in Polish patients with NSCLC.

pmc-11574143.title: Shortcut to chemically accurate quantum computing via density-based basis-set correction
pmc-11574143.creator: Diata Traore, Olivier Adjoua, César Feniou, Ioanna-Maria Lygatsika, Yvon Maday, Evgeny Posenitskiy, Kerstin Hammernik, Alberto Peruzzo, Julien Toulouse, Emmanuel Giner, Jean-Philip Piquemal
pmc-11574143.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Using GPU-accelerated state-vector emulation, we propose to embed a quantum computing ansatz into density-functional theory via density-based basis-set corrections to obtain quantitative quantum-chemistry results on molecules that would otherwise require brute-force quantum calculations using hundreds of logical qubits. Indeed, accessing a quantitative description of chemical systems while minimizing quantum resources is an essential challenge given the limited qubit capabilities of current quantum processors.

pmc-11583350.title: Assessment of the Clinicopathologic Characteristics and Survival Rates of Colorectal Cancer Among Syrian Refugees and Turkish Population in Gaziantep Province
pmc-11583350.creator: Canan Karan, İlker Nihat Okten, Oğuzhan Kesen, Atalay Çelikyürek, Fatih Teker, Şuayib Yalçın
pmc-11583350.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). PURPOSESyrian refugees (SRs) have had difficulties in the diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up of chronic diseases, such as cancer, because of the conflict in the region. The cancer diagnosis and treatment process of SR are also a matter of curiosity.

pmc-12374285.title: Willingness to use long-acting injectable pre-exposure prophylaxis among key populations at a large HIV prevention clinic in Kampala, Uganda: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12374285.creator: Jonathan Derrick Lukubuya, Elizabeth B. Katana, Micheal Baguma, Andrew Kaguta, Winnie Nambatya, Peter Kyambadde, Timothy R. Muwonge, Andrew Mujugira, Eva Agnes Laker Odongpiny
pmc-12374285.description: BackgroundLong-acting injectable (LAI)-PrEP provides better protection against HIV compared to oral PrEP, which requires taking a daily pill. Our study aimed to assess knowledge about oral and LAI-PrEP and identify factors associated with willingness to use LAI-PrEP among key populations (KPs) in Uganda.

pmc-12606715.title: Synthesis and Characterization of Phosphanophenolate-Based Rare-Earth Metal–Copper Complexes
pmc-12606715.creator: Andreas Fleißner, Viktoria Rehbein, Alexandra Haidinger, Christina I. Dilly, Antoine Dupé, Roland C. Fischer, Elise S. Hecht, Johann A. Hlina
pmc-12606715.description: The reaction of [LnIII(OArP-κ2 O,P)3] (1-Ln, Ln = La, Sm, Y, Yb, and ArPO– = 2,4-tBu2-6-(Ph2P)­C6H2O–) with the copper­(I) triflate toluene adduct yields the corresponding dinuclear rare-earth metal­(III)–copper­(I) complexes [LnIII(OTf)­(μ-OArP-1κ1 O,2κ1 P)3CuI] (2-Ln, Ln = La, Sm, Y, Yb) in clean conversion.

pmc-12619456.title: Inflammatory tropism in COVID-19: a comparative analysis of Delta and Omicron variants
pmc-12619456.creator: Afshin Samiei, Ali Jandaghi, Mehdi Hassani Azad, Mahmood Khayatian, Narges Khaghanzadeh
pmc-12619456.description: BackgroundThe clinical presentation of COVID-19 varies significantly by viral variant; the Delta variant often causes severe lung inflammation, whereas Omicron tends to result in less severe respiratory disease but may more readily affect other organs. The autoimmune mechanisms behind these variant-specific complications, particularly the potential role of anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic (ANCA) antibodies, are still not well defined.

pmc-13145538.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A59 ULTRA-EARLY CT PERFUSION–GUIDED DECISION-MAKING IN ACUTE ISCHAEMIC STROKE: A SYSTEMATIC REVIEW AND META-ANALYSIS
pmc-13145538.creator: Ibrahim Serag
pmc-13145538.description: Background and aimsUltra-early stroke assessment aims to reduce treatment delays, yet the comparative effectiveness of computed tomography perfusion (CTP) versus standard non-contrast CT (NCCT) remains uncertain. This meta-analysis synthesised evidence on whether CTP-based triage improves clinical and workflow outcomes in hyperacute ischaemic stroke.

pmc-13234056.title: Engineering quantum dot surfaces to preserve protein-DNA interactions for single-molecule visualization
pmc-13234056.creator: Youngseo Kim, Hyerim Kim, Munryul Choi, Hyun Suk Kim, Soyeong An, Orlando D Schärer, Jongnam Park, Ja Yil Lee
pmc-13234056.description: Quantum dots (QDs) are fluorescent nanoparticles widely used for single-molecule imaging because of their exceptional brightness and photostability. However, the impact of QD surface chemistry on biomolecular interactions has not been systematically investigated. Here, we report that commercial QDs unexpectedly destabilize protein-DNA complexes by inducing protein dissociation from DNA.

pmc-13369215.title: Prevalence and clinical characteristics of blown-out myotomy after E-POEM for achalasia: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13369215.creator: Yusuf Kagzi, Srinivas Reddy Puli
pmc-13369215.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAchalasia is a primary esophageal motility disorder characterized by impaired lower esophageal sphincter relaxation and absent peristalsis. Treatment options include Pneumatic Dilation, Laparoscopic Heller Myotomy, and Esophageal Peroral Endoscopic Myotomy (E-POEM). A focal distal esophageal dilation at the myotomy site, termed blown-out myotomy (BOM), has been reported in 9% – 32% of patients and may be associated with reflux, esophageal retention, and treatment failure. The clinical significance of BOM remains unclear.

pmc-13682462.title: Temporal interference stimulation for treating Wilson disease: A prospective clinical and functional MRI study
pmc-13682462.creator: Nan Cheng, Yanming Wang, Huiyu Du, Guofang Yu, Xiaojing Han, Yangfei Huang, Chunsheng Xu, Bensheng Qiu, Ting Dong
pmc-13682462.description: Wilson disease (WD) is an inherited disorder of copper metabolism caused by ATP7B mutations, and persistent neurological deficits, especially dystonia and motor disability, may remain despite standard anti-copper therapy. The putamen is a deep gray-matter nucleus frequently affected by copper deposition in WD and may therefore represent a plausible target for non-invasive neuromodulation.
